items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: Benny Goodman used to come up with the trio every Friday.

ctx.x: But that was a great education. We had, you know, regular school subjects, history and math and all the rest of it, but you had to keep up your grades in that too or out you go. But I got a chance to actually play in the symphony orchestra, and some great music. Things I never would have had a chance to play. So, and Benny Goodman used to come up with the trio every Friday. That was nice.
At the — he’d play at the school?
